title: 3D Sand Picture 20 cm – A New Landscape Every Time You Flip It
descriptionHtml:
The ornaments have looked the same since they were unpacked

The shelf is furnished and done – and dead. Nothing in the room changes until someone moves out.

The picture that redraws itself

Flip the frame and the sand slowly sinks through the liquid into a new mountain landscape – every time different from the last. Round frame, 20.2 cm wide, stands on a base on the shelf or the desk.

Features

  • A new picture every time – the sand never settles the same way twice
  • The calmest eye-catcher in the room – slow movement instead of yet another stationary ornament
  • Flipped with one grip – stands steadily on its own base
  • 20 cm round – takes up shelf space like a book, looks like a painting

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
